messages.author: 13d0e40ead8b0219
messages.subject: Stack overflow
parts:
Hi Karl,

I'm trying to calculate genotype probabilities for DO mice. I am using data for chromosome 1, which consists of ~4.7 million genomic positions. 

I keep getting the following error:
Error: segfault from C stack overflow
Execution halted

I have tried using anywhere from 1 to 8 cores, and I have also split the data to calculate probs for each mouse individually, but I am still getting the same error.

If it matters, I'm using 96 Gb of RAM.

Any help is appreciated.
Thanks,
Basel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Stack overflow
parts:
I would reduce the density of calculations you're trying to do.
How many SNPs are there on chromosome 1? Surely much less than 4.7 million.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Stack overflow
parts:
I would start by eliminating those that are not polymorphic across the 8 founder strains.

As I understand it, there are like 40 million polymorphic SNPs, genome-wide, among the 8 founders.
<3 million on chromosome 1.

I think the basic problem is that you're running into the maximum length of a vector in R, which is like 2^31 =~ 10^9
6 million positions x 36 possible genotypes =~ 2 x 10^8, so if you go beyond 9 individuals, you'd exceed vector size.

karl
